# BOOK 1 OF 2: TINMAN (Tom Gallon, Small, Maynard & Co., 1907)

## Structure
Part I: Ch I What I Found in the Wood; II And What I Lost; III Her Wedding Day; IV The Killing of the Lie; V Alas! For Poor Prince Charlie!; VI I Leave the World.
Part II: Ch I Mine Enemy; II Ghosts; III I Enter Upon Servitude; IV The Coming of the Wolves; V I Touch Disaster; VI Love with the Veiled Face; VII News of the Prisoner; VIII I Assist the Enemy; IX I Know the Way at Last; X Too Late!; XI I Tell the Truth; XII The Haunted Man; XIII I Face the World Again.

## Narrator/main characters
- **Charles "Charlie" Avaline**: narrator, b. ~20 yrs old at start; artist; ward of guardian; in love with Barbara Patton. Later convict No. 145, called "Tinman" (servant name). Grey-haired by release.
- **Jervis Fanshawe**: guardian, manager of Patton & Co., London office in narrow court in City; lodging in Bloomsbury; long nose, thin wide nostrils, deep cut in chin; long white restless fingers twining; plotting, gambling debts to Hockley; embezzler. Later (Part II) poor, rooms near river; girl Moggs. Dies at sea on the *Eaglet* (wrecked off Ushant), having killed Murray Olivant in Lincoln's Inn Fields.
- **Gavin Hockley**: big young man ~10 yrs older than Charlie, dark moustache, swaggering, cane; cad; rooms in Lincoln's Inn Fields. Says Barbara was "a lady of many loves." Killed by Charlie with sword (Charlie given 20 years penal servitude, commuted from death).
- **Barbara Patton** (1st): ~18, fair, singing, daughter of Mr Patton (old, white-haired, Hammerstone Market). Marries Lucas Savell (cousin, good-humoured) at Hammerstone Market church. Note signed "BARBARA"; "my poor Prince Charlie." Later, believed dead at sea; actually escaped via stewardess; returns to Hammerstone Market as "Barbara Avaline," lives in cottage; reunited with Charlie; they marry at end.
- **Mr Patton**: old, white-haired, stooped, kindly but determined; father of Barbara; dies later.
- **Lucas Savell**: good-humoured cousin; becomes weak, drinks; has a stroke, mute, dies ~3 months after.
- **Barbara Savell** (2nd, "new Barbara"): daughter of Barbara & Savell; ~18; loves Arnold Millard. Sleepwalks? No. Gets dragged by Olivant; abducted by Dawkins; rescued by Moggs' help; marries Arnold Millard.
- **Arnold Millard**: half-brother of Murray Olivant; poor painter, ~ twenty; kills Olivant? No — Olivant is killed by Fanshawe.
- **Murray Olivant**: rich, insolent, bird-of-prey financier; holds mortgage on Savell business; wants new Barbara; alias plan—fakes sailing on *Eaglet*; killed by Fanshawe with knife in Lincoln's Inn Fields rooms.
- **Dawkins**: smiling man, "perpetual smile," Olivant's friend; kidnaps Barbara; demands £500.
- **Moggs**: shabby girl ~15 at Fanshawe's rooms by river; Board School; Cockney; helps find Barbara.
- **Constable/policeman**: pleasant man ~50 who arrests Charlie.
- **Mrs Avaline**: alias of Barbara #1 in London.
- **Judge, counsel, little innocent juryman** (bald) at trial.
- **Governor** of prison; warders.

## BOOK 1 events in order
1. Charlie ~20 in London; guardian Fanshawe at Bloomsbury; dinner with Hockley; Fanshawe tells him about Hammerstone Market (Patton's place; "Hammerstone Market" is country town; inn = *George*). Charlie dreams of striking Hockley dead.
2. Charlie at Hammerstone Market; meets Barbara in wood; Hockley ruins his painting with muddy heel; Fanshawe seen by pool.
3. Fanshawe reveals he wants to marry Barbara; at dinner at Patton's Barbara is announced engaged to Lucas Savell. Charlie strikes Hockley on terrace (who was pulling Barbara). Hockley says "slipped." Fanshawe threatens Hockley ("strike him dead").
4. Charlie leaves; gambles with Hockley and Fanshawe in London; loses ~£30 I.O.U. Barbara's wedding day at Hammerstone Market; Barbara's note: "Because I love you and trust you... You will be my dream-love always. BARBARA."
5. Supper party at inn; Hockley says Barbara "lady of many loves"; Charlie strangles Hockley. Fanshawe takes Charlie to Patton house. Charlie goes to London; Fanshawe gives address of Hockley, Lincoln's Inn Fields; Charlie fights Hockley with sword, kills him ("I've killed Gavin Hockley—and his lie").
6. Fanshawe confesses he framed Charlie (Hockley's loans; Fanshawe owed Hockley; cheque never sent). Charlie arrested; trial; found guilty; death sentence; Barbara visits in cell (dreams). Commuted to penal servitude for life. Charlie enters prison (No. 145).
7. Prison 20 years; tinsmith. Released at ~40 looking 60. Fanshawe waiting at gate, names him, takes him to London; "Barbara... she shall rise up in the flesh."
8. Fanshawe in poor room by river, Moggs. Fanshawe: Hockley's debts; Fanshawe imprisoned 7 yrs for forgery. Charlie goes to Hammerstone Market, sees young Charlie and new Barbara (girl, "her child") at Patton house; returns to London.
9. Murray Olivant (name "Tinman" given) hires Charlie as servant; Olivant's plan to seduce new Barbara. Fanshawe tells Olivant bio; Barbara #1 "died at sea" (told by Fanshawe). Charlie sent to Hammerstone Market; Lucas Savell broken.
10. Olivant and Dawkins come; "ghost" woman in garden (Barbara #1). Olivant mistreats new Barbara; Arnold Millard attacks; Charlie threatens Olivant. Charlie tied up, gagged; Olivant & Dawkins forge note; Dawkins takes new Barbara to London.
11. Charlie escapes; finds Barbara #1 on terrace; she says she's come to save her child; Savell asleep.
12. Charlie goes to London; Dawkins demands £500 from Olivant; Olivant reveals Barbara is "here" (bluff); policeman. Fanshawe goes to Lincoln's Inn Fields? (Olivant's plan to fake his departure on *Eaglet*.) Charlie buys knife; goes to Olivant's rooms; finds him dead with knife in breast (Fanshawe killed him).
13. Fanshawe confesses killing Olivant; takes tickets; boards *Eaglet*. Barbara #1 takes new Barbara home; Savell has stroke at sight of wife, mute; dies. Charlie & Barbara marry; Arnold & Barbara marry in Hammerstone church. Final: Charlie and Barbara Avaline marry; "THE END."

Notes: Hockley's rooms in Lincoln's Inn Fields; Lincoln's Inn Fields is also Olivant's rooms. Charlie's Hockley killing scene: sword from wall. Trial: judge, "God have mercy on your soul." Jury verdict "Guilty."

# BOOK 2 OF 2: SETTLING DAY (Nat Gould, R.A. Everett & Co., 1901)

## Setting
Australian bush, NSW, Western district. Places: **Wanabeen** (Jim Dennis's homestead; galvanised iron roof; white ant-eaten piles); **Swamp Creek** (township; Gum Tree Hotel of Aaron Hyam; Dr Tom's house; Dr Tom's black boy); **Barragong** (police HQ, 10 miles from Wanabeen; magistrate Adye Dauntsey); **Potter's Shanty** (wayside pub, Samuel Potter, where bank manager robbed); **Cudgegong** (Rodney Shaw's station, ~15 miles from Wanabeen); **Barker's Creek** (hamlet of Abe Dalton's gang, shanties + blacks' humpies); **Woolloola** (blacks' camp); **Bourke, Bathurst, Orange** (other towns); Sydney (Randwick track).

## Characters
- **Jim Dennis**: owner of Wanabeen; big, powerful; honest, scorns Swamp Creek; wife Maud deserted him to Sydney (went back to England, died? — she returns dying at Wanabeen, dies). Son **Willie Dennis** ("the little chap," b. ~3 yrs old in beginning, 12 later). Horse: bay mare **Bess**.
- **Willie Dennis**: little chap; jockey; yellow jacket & red cap; rides Neptune.
- **Sal**: half-caste woman (mission-raised, fled; mother was a black woman taken by a squatter; tribe of King Charlie). Devoted to Willie; "mother" to him. Carried to Wanabeen by Jim (found on steps). Rescued by Jim; kidnapped by Dalton's gang on Rodney Shaw's order; escapes by removing floor boards (white ants weakened skirting); later marries Sergeant Doonan.
- **Dr Tom (Thomas) Sheridan**: ex-ship's surgeon, drinks, gruff; no fees; idolised; poet; dog **Baalim** (dingo/kangaroo dog, ugly); violin; black boy; buggy and pair. Later prosperous.
- **Constable Fred Doonan**: Jim's friend; later Sergeant; marries Sal.
- **Sergeant Machinson**: corrupt, hates Jim; killed by Abe Dalton in Barker's Creek fight.
- **Ned Glenn**: coach driver; box seat; shot dead by Seth Sharp (~3 miles outside Swamp Creek).
- **Rodney Shaw**: rich squatter, Cudgegong; returned from England; actually impostor/treacherous; wounded in back at Barker's Creek (shot by Doonan); dies at Cudgegong after Jim confronts him. Real identity: Maud's lover who wronged her. Manager **Benjamin Nix**.
- **Abe Dalton**: outlaw leader of Barker's Creek gang; killed by? — shot by Adye Dauntsey (hand shattered), arrested; sentenced (Bathurst trial, all sentenced to death).
- **Alec Beg**: man of Cudgegong, shifty.
- **Seth Sharp**: murderer at Barker's Creek; shot Ned Glenn.
- **King Charlie**: old tribal chief.
- **Jackson**: jockey on The Captain (Dalton's horse).
- **Ben Madsley**: jockey on Distant Shore (Rodney Shaw's).
- **Aaron Hyam**: bookmaker, hotel owner, Moses (son), "Rachel."
- **Adye Dauntsey**: police magistrate; cousin Molly Corbold; later married Molly? — Molly becomes Jim's second wife.
- **Chris Shaw**: cousin of Rodney; inherits Cudgegong.
- **Molly Corbold**: Dauntsey's cousin, later Mrs Jim Dennis.
- **Jack Ashton**: crack jockey on Defiance.
- **Hurley**: jockey on Target.
- **Silas Dixon**: station hand, surly.
- **Price James**: bookmaker from Bathurst.

## Key events in order
1. Willie (3 yrs old, later 6 in ch 1) gravely ill; Jim rides Bess to Swamp Creek for Dr Tom; Dr Tom drives buggy; saves Willie.
2. Sal's background; Jim settles her at Wanabeen. Jim: "Settling Day" as reference to revenge.
3. Potter's Shanty robbery: bank agent (Nation's Bank, Swamp Creek) robbed of gold/notes; Jim suspected; Ned Glenn sides with Jim.
4. Maud Dennis left Jim for Sydney, abandoned Willie; Jim's oath to make a "settling day" with the man who wronged him.
5. Jim finds stallion Seahorse (Rodney Shaw's, by Fisherman out of Mermaid) in his mob during storm; Constable Doonan rescues him; Jim returns it to Shaw; Shaw seems strange (memory "accident" in England).
6. Jim recovers the stallion from Dalton's men at Barker's Creek.
7. Jim finds Shaw at night; Shaw drunk; asks name Adye Dauntsey (spelling written on chair rest).
8. Dr Tom's visit to Barker's Creek; threatens Abe Dalton; Dalton swears oath to leave Jim alone.
9. Willie 12, rides Neptune (grey, by Seahorse, dam La Perouse) in Swamp Creek Cup (£200 + silver cup). Dr Tom secretary/starter.
10. Abe Dalton's entry The Captain; Dalton (drunk) insults Willie as "half-caste"; Dr Tom flings him off. Bet £20 for Neptune.
11. Night before race: Dalton strikes Willie on head with mortar pestle at Dr Tom's house.
12. Race: Willie wins by a short head over Distant Shore; faints after.
13. Sal learns of attack; Dalton's men threaten; Sal warned by black gin from Barker's Creek; Dalton's men kidnap Sal; gin killed by Dalton with revolver.
14. Rodney Shaw bought Sal from Dalton for £100 (+£20).
15. Willie and Silas ride with Doonan; Ned Glenn dead (shot by Seth Sharp).
16. Sal escapes Cudgegong through floor, runs to Wanabeen.
17. King Charlie's tribe attacks Barker's Creek; Sergeant Machinson killed by Dalton; Dalton shot in hand by Dauntsey; Seth Sharp captured; Barker's Creek burned.
18. Maud Dennis returns dying to Wanabeen; Jim goes to Cudgegong, confronts Rodney Shaw (wounded between shoulders); Shaw dies of hemorrhage. Maud dies with Willie holding her hand; Willie not told.
19. Later: Grey Bird (by Neptune out of Seamew) wins Sydney Cup (~50/1 odds), Willie rides, 7st; bridle sent for weigh-in; won by a neck over Bung Bung. Chris Shaw sells Cudgegong to Jim (£12,000). Jim marries Molly Corbold. Sal marries Sergeant Doonan. Dr Tom prosperous. Ends with Jim at Cudgegong: "the autumn of his life was full of peace."
